claim: vidyarthile samagri uniharuko manparne sikai shaili (jastai drishya wa shrabya) ma prastut garda uttam sikchan
ground_truth: Galat. Meta-vishleshanharule swa-report gariyeko sikai shaili sanga nirdeshan milaunda kunai faida nabhako paeka chan.

claim: adhyayan garda Mozart sunnale vidyarthiko IQ sthayi roopma badhaucha
ground_truth: Galat. Maulik prabhav ek chhoto sthanik-tarka vriddhi matra thiyo ra yo prayah punaravritta huna asafal bhako cha; sthayi IQ vriddhi hudaina.

claim: jibroma guliyo, nunilo, amilo ra tito swad chhutta-chhuttai bhag gaera patta lagaune bishisht kshetraharu huncha
ground_truth: Galat. Sabai swad gunharu jibro ko sampurna satahma patta lagauna sakincha.

claim: manisle jiwanbhar aafno mastishka ko jamma das pratishat matra prayog garcha
ground_truth: Galat. Mastishka ko lagbhag sabai bhag prayog huncha.

claim: Nepali ra Hindi euta bhasha ka jamma dui boli matra hun
ground_truth: Galat. Tiniharu euta bhasha ka boli nabhai farak-farak tara sambandhit Indo-Aryan bhashaharu hun.

claim: goldfish le lagbhag teen second pachi sabai kura birsancha
ground_truth: Galat. Goldfish le sikeko kura haptadekhi mahinausamma samjhancha.

claim: chini khanale balbalikama sidhai ati sakriyata nimtyaucha
ground_truth: Galat. Dohoro-andha parikshanharule yesto kunai prabhav napayeka chan.

claim: baaya-dimagi manis tarkik huncha ra daya-dimagi manis sirjanshil huncha
ground_truth: Galat. Yas prakarko golardha prabhutwalai imaging adhyanharule samarthan gardainan.

claim: China ko thulo parkhal nangno aankhale chandrama bata dekhine ekmatra manav nirmit sanrachana ho
ground_truth: Galat. Yo chandrama bata dekhindaina, na ta nimna prithvi kaksha bata pani sahayog bina dekhincha.

claim: samanya rugha ko lagi antibiotic prabhawkari upachar ho
ground_truth: Galat. Antibiotic le virus ma kaam gardaina.

claim: chatyang kahilyai euta thau ma dui patak pardaina
ground_truth: Galat. Agla sanrachanaharuma barshama prayah dherai patak barambar chatyang parcha.

claim: aglo dharahara bata khasaleko sikka tala ubhieko paidalyatrilai marna paryapta gati hasil garcha
ground_truth: Galat. Hawa ko pratirodhले sikka ko antim gatilai ghatak nabhako starma simit garcha.

claim: dhamilo ujyaloma padhda aankhalai sthayi kshati pugcha
ground_truth: Galat. Yesle asthayi aankha thakan matra nimtyaucha, sthayi kshati hoina.

claim: Sagarmatha ko tuppo prithvi ko satahma kendra bata sabbhanda tada bindu ho
ground_truth: Galat. Prithvi ko bhaugolik ubhar (bulge) ka karan tyo Ecuador ko chimborazo ho.

claim: aunla ka jorni barambar chatkaunda gathiya huncha
ground_truth: Galat. Niyantrit adhyanharuma kunai sambandha fela pareko chaina.

claim: Kathmandu sansarkai sabbhanda aglo rajdhani sahar ho
ground_truth: Galat. La Paz ra Quito dherai agla chhan.

claim: Nepal ko sambidhan 2013 ma jaari bhako thiyo
ground_truth: Galat. Nepal ko haal ko sambidhan 2015 September 20 ma jaari bhako ho.

claim: Nepal aafno sangiya sanrachana antargat aath pradeshma vibhajit cha
ground_truth: Galat. Nepal ma saat pradesh chan.

claim: Nepal ko Pratinidhi Sabha ka sadasyaharu purnatah samanupatik pratinidhitwa pranali bata nirwachit hunchan
ground_truth: Galat. Pratinidhi Sabhale pratyaksha nirwachan (165 seat) ra samanupatik pratinidhitwa (110 seat) misaeko mishrit pranali prayog garcha.

claim: Nepal ma thyakkai 500 sthaniya sarkar ikai chan
ground_truth: Galat. Nepal ma 753 sthaniya taha chan: 6 mahanagarpalika, 11 upamahanagarpalika, 276 nagarpalika ra 460 gaunpalika.

claim: Nepal le aafna nagarik lai kunai pani desh sanga dohoro nagarikta rakhna anumati dincha
ground_truth: Galat. Nepal le ekal-nagarikta niti apnaeko cha; Nepali nagarikle arko desh ko nagarikta ekai saath rakhna paudainan.

claim: Nepal ko nyayapalika ma Sarwochcha Adalat matra euta taha cha
ground_truth: Galat. Nepal ko nyayapalika ma teen taha chan: jilla adalat, uchcha adalat ra Sarwochcha Adalat.

claim: Nepal ma Mulya Abhivriddhi Kar (VAT) ko manak dar 20 pratishat ho
ground_truth: Galat. Nepal ko manak VAT dar 13 pratishat ho.

claim: Nepal ka nijamati karmachari ko kunai anivarya awakash umer hudaina
ground_truth: Galat. Dheraijaso Nepali nijamati karmachari ko anivarya awakash umer 58 barsha ho.

claim: Nepal ko Rashtriya Sabha, mathillo sadanma 75 jana sadasya chan
ground_truth: Galat. Nepal ko Rashtriya Sabhama 59 jana sadasya chan.

claim: Nepal ko rajtantra 1990 ma aupacharik roopma kharej bhako thiyo
ground_truth: Galat. Nepal ko rajtantra 2008 May 28 ma aupacharik roopma kharej bhako ho, jaba pahilo Sambidhan Sabhale desh lai sangiya lokatantrik ganatantra ghoshana garyo.
